newsitem.title: USA: Maxxon to acquire medical distributor.
newsitem.headline: Maxxon to acquire medical distributor.

text.p: Maxxon Inc said Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Ives Health Co in exchange for $1,750,000 in restricted common stock of Maxxon.

Ives Health distributes homeopathic medicines, preventive health products, and nutritional supplements, in 21 states. Its revenues are expected to reach about $6 million within the next 18 months, Maxxon said.
The acquisition will be accounted for as a purchase and a definitive agreement is expected to be completed within 30 days, Maxxon said in a statement.

"This acquisition is consistent with our goal of developing and marketing products that offer unique advantages or improvements over existing healthcare products or services," said Gifford Mabie, Maxxon chairman said in a statement.
Maxxon is developing a patented, disposable safety syringe that automatically retracts the needle into the plunger after use, thereby eliminating the risk of accidental needlestick injuries.
